name: Eastern Kentucky University
tuition_note: In-state (Kentucky resident) tuition & fees 2026-27 from eku.edu/tuition-and-aid: $5,325 flat-rate tuition + $150 Special Use + $150 Asset Preservation + $255 Exceptional Eastern Experience + $153 Student Health = $6,033/semester x 2 = $12,066/year. Housing (room only) from eku.edu/housing 2025-26: Tier 1 Community double-occupancy $3,220/semester x 2 = $6,440/year (lowest standard rate); rates range up to $10,100/year for apartments. Board (meal plans) not included.
